y-m-22-07.title: Tinogona kutaura 'kaviri zvakawanda' kubva pahurefu hwemabhari chete here?
y-m-22-07.topic: Kuverenga histograms: kutanga kwe vertical axis kunokanganisa sei kuenzanisa hurefu hwemabhari
y-m-22-07.goal: Cherechedza kuti mu histogram isina vertical axis inotanga pa 0 ratio yehurefu hwemabhari inosiyana neratio yema frequency, tonga musiyano kubva pama frequency chaiwo, uye unyore zvakare senotice isingakonzeri kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
y-m-22-07.material:
Histogram yakadhindwa munotice yeraibhurari. Inopatsanura vadzidzi 142 kuita ma class 3 nehuwandu hwemabhuku avakatora mumwedzi.
[Histogram inotsanangurwa mumashoko] Horizontal axis inoratidza '0 kana kupfuura uye shoma kupfuura 5 mabhuku', '5 kana kupfuura uye shoma kupfuura 10 mabhuku', ne '10 kana kupfuura uye shoma kupfuura 15 mabhuku'. Vertical axis i huwandu hwevadzidzi, ine makisi kubva pasi kuenda pamusoro pa 40, 44, 48, 52 vadzidzi. Pasi pemakisi 40 hapana kudhirowa pamufananidzo. Ma frequency chaiwo emabhari 3 i 46, 52, 44 vadzidzi nenhevedzano.
Shoko renotice: "Vadzidzi vakawanda zvikuru vakatora mabhuku 5 kana kupfuura uye shoma kupfuura 10! Ikaviri yema class mamwe."

Hurefu hunoratidzika se 6:12:4, asi huwandu chaiwo hwevadzidzi i 46:52:44. Mutsetse 4 i mhedziso inovakirwa pamutsetse 2, saka wakaipawo. Mitsetse 1 ne 3 inonyora zvinhu zvinoonekwa nemaziso mumufananidzo.

y-m-22-08.title: Kuedza chirevo che 'anenge hafu yevadzidzi vari pamusoro pe mean'
y-m-22-08.topic: Mean nekugoverwa kwedata: huwandu hwemitengo iri pamusoro pe mean
y-m-22-08.goal: Edza nekugadzira counterexamples iwe pachako kana pfungwa yekuti 'huwandu hwemitengo iri pamusoro nepasi pe mean anenge akafanana' inoshanda nguva dzose, uye utsanangure kuti sei mean ne median zvichiita zvakasiyana pahuwandu hwemitengo yepamusoro.
y-m-22-08.material: Tinotaura nezvemamakisi ebasa (integers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 100) evadzidzi 5. Mina akati, "Vadzidzi vakawana mamakisi akakwirira kupfuura mean vanogara vari anenge hafu yevese, uye hafu imwe yakawana mamakisi akadzika kupfuura mean." Mean i mutengo waunowana nekuwedzera mamakisi evadzidzi 5 uye kupatsanura ne 5. Mudzidzi ane makisi akaenzana ne mean haiswi kudivi re 'yakakwira' kana re 'yakadzika'.

y-m-22-02.title: Kutsvaga mutsara usina kururama mumhinduro yenguva yekuverenga
y-m-22-02.topic: Kufungidzira mean kubva patafura ye frequency: kugadzirisa mutsara usina kururama mumhinduro
y-m-22-02.goal: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa mutsara usina kururama mumhinduro inofungidzira mean uchishandisa ma midpoint ekirasi kubva patafura ye frequency, uye vaka tsika yekuziva kuti kukosha kwakawanikwa ifungidziro uye kutarisa kuti hukuru hwayo huri mukati merenji ye data here.
y-m-22-02.material:
Nguva (maminetsi) yevadzidzi 20 vanoverenga mabhuku pazuva yakarongwa mutafura ye frequency. Kirasi imwe neimwe ndi 'maminetsi ○ kana kupfuura uye pasi pemaminetsi ○'.

Tafura ye frequency haina nguva chaiyo yemudzidzi mumwe nemumwe, saka tinofungidzira mean nekufunga kuti mudzidzi wese mukirasi akaverenga kwenguva iri pakati pekirasi iyoyo (class mark). Pazasi ndiyo mhinduro yemudzidzi mumwe.

y-m-22-06.material:
Huwandu hwemajampu ejump-rope (nguva, nhamba dzakazara) dzakaitwa nevadzidzi 16 mumaminiti 1, dzakarongwa kubva padiki zvikuru, ndidzi.
8, 12, 15, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 25, 26, 28, 31, 34, 37, 41, 55
Marekodhi aya akarongwa mutafura yehuwandu. Pane makirasi mashanu, ose akaenzana muhukuru, akanyorwa se 'nguva ○ kana kupfuura uye shoma pa nguva ○'. Kirasi yekutanga inotanga panguva a kana kupfuura uye kuwanda kwekirasi ndi nguva w (a inhamba yechisikigo ye 0 kana kupfuura, w inhamba yechisikigo ye 1 kana kupfuura). Ndiko kuti, makirasi anoenda nenhevedzano: a kana kupfuura uye shoma pa a+w, a+w kana kupfuura uye shoma pa a+2w, … Mamiriro anotevera anofanira kuchengetwa. ① Marekodhi evadzidzi vose 16 anowira mukati memakirasi mashanu ② Hapana kirasi isina chinhu ③ Hapana kirasi ine vadzidzi vanopfuura 8 (hafu yehuwandu hwose).
